nodes.title: Owner (2026-10-04): STT cost plan = MAI-Transcribe-2 as the preferred live STT (best case; price confirmed from the Azure bill on 2026-10-06), test gpt-transcribe ($0.27/h) on the Hinglish child corpus as the cheap Azure option, and adopt speech-gated streaming: the mic and an on-device speech detector run for the whole session (barge-in and mid-turn questions unchanged), audio goes to STT only while speech is present, with ~300 ms pre-roll. Partly supersedes owner-always-listen-full-session-2026-10-04 (listening stays always-on; silence is no longer transcribed). Reverse if speech gating misses child speech or barge-ins in testing (any measurable clipped onsets) or MAI's billed price exceeds gpt-live-transcribe.
